title: Улитка продолжает путь

beats.action: Hold on the same path and lighting; Mia and Stepa watch the snail from a respectful distance.
Mia notices the faint shiny trail on the ground and points without touching it.
beats.camera: gentle tilt to the trail, keep Mia's hand visible

beats.action: Stepa leans slightly to see better but stays on the path.
beats.camera: two-shot with the trail in foreground

beats.action: Both children pause and observe; snail continues slowly on its own.

safety_gates: No touching, lifting, or moving the snail.
